purpose: append-only causal-world experience memory with structural recall and outcome-driven adaptation

substrate.coexists_with: the Primitive Forge causal-glyph catalog in the same Atom DB store

source_artifacts.binding: every imported batch carries the SHA-256 identity of its exact source artifact

records.observation_revision: one immutable identity per complete observation payload, including repeated source labels
records.causal_law: one consolidated relationship with graph-native links to every supporting observation revision
records.motif: content identity of experience, structural role, and value
records.audit_boundary: source hashes, provenance, and evidence metadata are durable but cannot participate in recall

append_protocol.idempotency: an already committed content-identical batch returns committed=false without changing the snapshot
append_protocol.versioning: changed source content receives a new batch identity and causal append position

retrieval.method: exact role-value motif resonance over cause, effect, context, domain, direction, kind, state, metrics, and ordered root composition
retrieval.required_constraints: every required structural feature must match before a record is answerable
retrieval.unknown_policy: return answerable=false, insufficient_evidence=true, and no hits

adaptation.input: an observed expected experience and the experience selected by the causal field
adaptation.correct_outcome: strengthen the matched structural motifs on the expected selection
adaptation.wrong_outcome: weaken the misleading selected motifs and strengthen the matching expected motifs
adaptation.persistence: commit the feedback event and exact motif adjustments in an atomic cell
adaptation.recall_policy: recall is read-only and adaptation occurs only through an explicit observation command

runtime_knowledge.binding: wiki nodes, evidence edges, and RAG results are rebuilt from the exact durable catalog

artifact_side_view.binding: the visible view validates the report, inventory, workflow, knowledge, and store hashes before rendering

measurement_boundary: the current runtime demonstrates durable structural memory and feedback over the saved causal-world corpus; it does not by itself establish open-domain language intelligence or autonomous truth acquisition
